name: PeatFireBench
description: Code and derived data accompanying the manuscript Evaluation choices decide fire-prediction model rankings and whether they transfer between provinces: evidence from Indonesian Kalimantan. Builds district-month panels of VIIRS S-NPP active fire detections for the 14 districts of West Kalimantan and the 55 districts of Indonesian Kalimantan, using GADM 4.1 administrative boundaries rather than a bounding box, and evaluates seven forecasting models under a 2x2 design crossing the test distribution (balanced or natural prevalence) with the discrimination metric (ROC-AUC or AUC-PR). Includes severity-threshold sensitivity, isotonic calibration fitted on out-of-fold predictions, bootstrap and per-year intervals, pooled and per-district severity targets, a negative result for the Indian Ocean Dipole, leave-one-province-out transfer, training-scope and province-identity tests, and a sensitivity analysis with thresholds computed from training years only. Version 1.2.0 adds the five-province analysis; the West Kalimantan analysis of version 1.1.0 is unchanged. The derived panels (2,464 and 9,240 district-months) are included. Raw FIRMS detections and GADM boundaries are not redistributed; both are free to obtain and the README documents how.
